summary: Resolve address questions to concise cited answers
description: Add a bounded deterministic address-intent retrieval path that searches subject evidence, extracts street-address candidates, ranks them by support and proximity, and renders a concise cited answer without model inference or private fixtures.
acceptance: A synthetic address question outranks lexical footer matches and returns the supported street address first
The answer remains bounded, cited, local, read-only, and sub-second

concerns: Deterministic property-intent answer extraction and evidence ranking
